'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Terwilliger DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Twigs Down
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
